brief:
Islamic Jihad will not run candidates in upcoming elections and will instead support a unified national list, according to deputy secretary-general Muhammad al-Hindi, the Shehab Wire reported. The movement's decision represents a shift in its electoral strategy ahead of Palestinian voting.

Al-Hindi characterized Operation al-Aqsa Flood as a historic event that will reshape the fate of Palestine and the broader region. He stressed the importance of Palestinian resistance maintaining independent decision-making and rejected unspecified claims regarding the movement's political direction. The statement underscores Islamic Jihad's positioning alongside other Palestinian factions in a coordinated electoral approach.
